The Term commences on November 1, 2020 and expires on October 31, 2030.
Rent shall be paid as follows: Year 1: $12,000.00; Year 4: $13,200.00; Year 7: $14,520.00.

notes: Non-consecutive year numbers (1, 4, 7) -- Year 4's rate triggers on the 3-year anniversary (2023-11-01), Year 7's on the 6-year anniversary (2026-11-01). Year 1 is still the starting rent, not a trigger.
